_app_setup: 1. Go to https://api.slack.com/apps and click 'Create New App'.
2. Choose 'From scratch', give it a name (e.g., 'Claude Dev Assistant'), and select your workspace.
3. Under 'OAuth & Permissions', add the following Bot Token Scopes:
channels:history   — read message history from public channels
channels:read      — list public channels and get channel info
users:read         — resolve user IDs to display names in summaries
Only add additional scopes if you have a specific, reviewed use case.
4. Click 'Install to Workspace' and copy the Bot User OAuth Token (starts with xoxb-).
5. Invite the bot to each channel it needs to read: /invite @your-bot-name
The bot can only read channels it has been explicitly added to.
6. Find your Team ID in your Slack workspace URL: https://app.slack.com/client/T01234567
The T-prefixed string is your SLACK_TEAM_ID.
- Private channels and DMs are not accessible unless the bot is explicitly invited.
- Do not invite the bot to channels containing HR, legal, or executive discussions.
- Review which channels the bot is in quarterly and remove it from channels no longer needed.

slack._comment: Connects Claude to Slack message history. SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_TEAM_ID must be set before starting Claude.
slack._least_privilege: Bot is scoped to channels:history and channels:read. It can only read channels it has been invited to.

env._comment_env: Export SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_TEAM_ID in your shell profile. Never paste token values here.
